description:
List import requirements. List category requirements for product, with optional category and for_children; returns applicable requirements, citations, labels and testing notes. For a reliable result, pass category, one of: toys_children, collectibles_adult, baby_items, apparel_children, jewelry_children, jewelry_adult, stationery_children, button_cell_magnet, apparel_adult, footwear, bags, home_textiles, rugs, window_coverings, furniture_storage, candles, party_decor, sports_outdoor, electronics_basic, wireless_devices, lithium_battery, plug_in_appliances, chargers_power, phone_accessories, string_lights, personal_care_electric, cosmetics, nail_hair_beauty_tools, food_contact, baby_feeding, pet_products, antimicrobial_repellent, eyewear, medical_claim_products, adult_bed_rail, pool_drain_cover, atv. Show top_3 to the user first. free, rate-limited.
品类合规门槛。按 product 及可选 category、for_children 列品类合规门槛；返回适用要求、出处、标签和检测说明。 想要准确结果请直接传 category（品类 id 见英文说明）。 先把 top_3 给用户看。免费，限次。
